sentences.text: The fossil material includes an almost complete skull with a lower jaw and a partial skeleton where many bones remain connected in their natural positions. Unaysaurus was a small dinosaur measuring 2.5 meters in length, 70 to 80 centimeters in height, and weighing approximately 70 kilograms.
Unaysaurus was a bipedal dinosaur that walked on two legs, similar to most early dinosaurs.
Unaysaurus is recognized as one of the oldest known dinosaurs.
A juvenile specimen of Unaysaurus associated with the holotype was described in 2023 by Müller and colleagues.
Unaysaurus was discovered in 1998 in the Paleorrota geopark in southern Brazil and officially announced on December 3, 2004.

The genus name Unaysaurus is derived from the Tupi word for 'black water', referring to the Agua Negra region where fossils were found. The species name tolentinoi honors Tolentino Marafiga, the person who found the fossils in 1998.
Unaysaurus tolentinoi was described as a new genus and species in 2004 by Leal, Azevodo, Kellner, and da Rosa.
The relationship between Unaysaurus and plateosaurids in Germany suggests that species could easily spread across the supercontinent Pangaea.
The Caturrita Formation, where Unaysaurus fossils were found, contains a wide variety of fauna and is part of the Santa Maria 2 Sequence.
Unaysaurus is classified as a herbivorous sauropodomorph dinosaur belonging to the family Unaysauridae.

When first described, Unaysaurus was initially classified within the family Plateosauridae. In 2018, Unaysaurus was reclassified into the new clade Unaysauridae, grouping it with Macrocollum and Jaklapallisaurus.
Research indicated that the closest relative of Unaysaurus was Plateosaurus, a species that lived approximately 210 million years ago in Germany.
Unaysaurus lived during the late Triassic period, specifically between 225 and 200 million years ago in the Carnian or Norian ages.

Unaysaurus inhabited southern Brazil, a region that was connected to northwest Africa during the Triassic. During the time Unaysaurus lived, the Earth was dominated by the supercontinent Pangaea, which was beginning to split into Laurasia and Gondwana.
